panels.title: Nodes Ready / NotReady
panels.description: Live KSM node conditions. Missing KSM is NO DATA. Unknown readiness is shown separately.

panels.title: Stable model
panels.description: Durable version from Router-v2 ReleaseCollector; not proof of complete backend rollout.

panels.title: Active candidate
panels.description: Absent during IDLE is NO DATA, not model version zero. Check phase and source health.

panels.title: Canary weight
panels.description: Effective Router-v2 percentage. This dashboard never changes it.

panels.title: Stable HPA current / max
panels.description: Current and maximum replicas from KSM; a configured max is not scale-out evidence.

panels.title: Nodes / EC2 compute estimate
panels.description: EC2 compute estimate only: live node count × editable USD/hour ×730. Assumes every counted node is t3.medium Linux On-Demand Singapore. Excludes EKS, EBS, transfer, tax and T3 Unlimited credits. AWS Pricing verified 2026-10-09:0.0528 USD/hour.

panels.title: Stable / Canary RPS
panels.description: Actual forwarded requests, including explicitly run synthetic tests. Source fixed to production Router-v2; namespace affects Kubernetes panels. Zero is valid only with healthy scrape.

panels.title: 5xx error ratio
panels.description: No traffic => NO DATA. No zero-fill, denominator clamp, or legacy router metrics.

panels.title: p50 / p95 latency
panels.description: Histogram quantiles across all Router-v2 instances, masked when no observations exist. No gaps bridged.

panels.title: Node CPU used / allocatable
panels.description: Root cgroup CPU from authenticated kubelet/cAdvisor, compared with schedulable CPU from KSM. Requires node label on scrape targets.

panels.title: Node memory working set / allocatable
panels.description: Root cgroup working set includes system processes; allocatable excludes reserved memory. No fabricated node metrics.

panels.title: Per-Pod CPU usage / request / limit
panels.description: Cores by Pod; regular container requests/limits, excluding init-container scheduling maxima. Missing limits stay absent.

panels.title: Per-Pod memory usage / request / limit
panels.description: Working set and regular container request/limit bytes. Missing metrics are not zero.

panels.title: Per-Pod CPU utilization ratios
panels.description: Usage/request and usage/limit; absent or zero denominators yield NO DATA.

panels.title: Per-Pod memory utilization ratios
panels.description: Working set/request and working set/limit; no synthetic denominator.

panels.title: Pod inventory
panels.description: All selected namespace Pods: name, namespace, node, active phase, Ready and restarts. KSM uses raw API state; readiness is not model identity.

panels.title: KServe InferenceServices
panels.description: Get-only exporter: Ready, metadata/observed generation, mode and latest revision. Standard mode absent revision = N/A. Cross-check Deployment convergence below; Ready alone is insufficient.

panels.title: HPA details
panels.description: KServe-owned autoscalers. Missing target metrics may require KSM metric opt-in; do not infer utilization from replica counts.

panels.title: Deployment rollout convergence
panels.description: KSM generation, observedGeneration, desired, updated, ready and available must agree before claiming rollout complete. Identity evidence additionally checks annotations/artifact/image out of band.

panels.title: Prometheus scrape health
panels.description: Every discovered target: 1=UP,0=DOWN. A target absent from discovery is absent, not healthy; inspect source presence too.

panels.title: Pod readiness timeline
panels.description: Minimum container readiness per selected Pod. Empty intervals remain gaps.

panels.title: Operational alert conditions
panels.description: Conditions only, no notifications: HPA desired>current (investigate5m), CrashLoop2m, target down2m, BLOCKED1m, stale snapshot. Zero requires present healthy telemetry; missing remains NO DATA.

panels.title: Release state
panels.description: Current phase and bounded pending states; durable state does not alone prove backend readiness.

panels.title: Release phase timeline
panels.description: One active phase at a time; metric disappears on stale snapshot.

panels.title: Router state freshness
panels.description: Age of last successful state read and snapshot freshness. Age>10s is stale; missing telemetry is not healthy.

panels.title: Release audit / stage timestamps
panels.description: Latest retained durable audit timestamps; these are historical timestamps, not newly replayed events. New-event annotations use exporter counters with startup baseline.

panels.title: Required telemetry source presence
panels.description: 1=family present; 0=absent from selected datasource. This is source presence, not serving health.

panels.title: Evidence / runbook
panels.description: Static links and explicit operational limits. No synthetic traffic or release mutation from dashboard.

options.content:
### Read-only operational view
[Runbook](https://github.com/Ngducanh05/ml_template/blob/feat/canary-monitoring-demo/docs/mlops-v2-dashboard.md) · [Evidence](https://github.com/Ngducanh05/ml_template/blob/feat/canary-monitoring-demo/docs/mlops-v2-dashboard.md#evidence-and-live-acceptance)

**NO DATA is not healthy.** Check source presence before interpreting zero traffic. ISVC Ready alone is not complete rollout proof. EC2 estimate excludes EKS/EBS/network/tax/T3 credits. Never use this view to infer an autoscaling PASS without a recorded desired/ready transition.
